before: A checkpoint wrote a table record that holds a removed column from only the cells the record held, so a row made after the record went too and the grid lost a column that row still uses. A checkpoint's drawing also made the engine refuse the column removal, so the cell before the removed column lost the width and the span it takes.
after: A checkpoint leaves out only the cells of later columns when it writes such a record, and draws the removal as live, so the table is the same live and after a fold.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: only the properties a checkpoint writes for those tables change, and every reader reads them as before. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
